description: Scrape a single Amazon product page (price, specs, ratings) by ASIN.

asin.description: Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN) of the product.

country.description: Two-letter ISO marketplace country code. (API default: us)

domain.description: Amazon TLD, e.g. com, in, de, co.uk. (API default: com)

postal_code.description: Postal/ZIP code to localize price and availability.

name: amazon_product
title: Amazon Product API
